prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” tanning salon for everyone — it depends on whether you want spray (sunless) tanning or UV beds, your budget, and which Columbus neighborhood you’re in. I can help you find the best option for your needs; quick questions first:

- Do you want spray/airbrush (sunless) tanning or UV tanning (beds/booths)?
- What area or ZIP code in Columbus are you near?
- Any priorities: lowest price, best results, highest hygiene, organic solutions, or trained techs?

While you decide, here’s a short checklist you can use to pick a top salon:

- Reviews: Google/Yelp rating 4.0+ with recent (last 6–12 months) positive photos and comments.
- Cleanliness & ventilation: booths and waiting area should look well-kept; ask about cleaning frequency.
- Equipment & solution quality: for spray tan, ask what solution/brand they use and whether it’s custom-blended; for UV, check bed brands and bulb replacement schedule.
- Staff training: look for certified spray technicians or licensed estheticians; ask about patch tests for first-time clients.
- Before/after photos: ask to see recent client photos (Instagram or in-salon).
- Safety & hygiene: protective eyewear, disposable or sanitized items, clear contraindications explained.
- Pricing & packages: check first-time specials, memberships, and upgrade add-ons; read cancellation policy.
- Location & hours: convenient hours and easy booking (online or app) matter.

If you tell me spray vs. UV and your neighborhood or ZIP, I’ll give a short list of well-rated Columbus salons and what each is best for. If you prefer, I can also draft a short message you can send to salons asking the right questions. Which would you like?
